title: Dance-Pop
tagline: Pop hooks designed to move with the pulse of the dance floor.
summary: Dance-pop combines concise pop songwriting with club-ready rhythms and production. Strong choruses, steady beats, and polished arrangements help songs work both on radio and on the dance floor. The style has absorbed disco, house, electronic music, and contemporary production trends while remaining centered on memorable vocal melodies.

pillars.name: Madonna
pillars.why: Madonna repeatedly connected pop songwriting with club production and dance-centered performance.

pillars.name: Janet Jackson
pillars.why: Jackson's rhythmic vocals and tightly arranged productions helped define an influential dance-pop sound.

pillars.name: Kylie Minogue
pillars.why: Minogue built a long-running catalog around bright hooks and polished dance-pop production.
